candidate_changes.add_haa_residual: Add residualized horizontal approach angle (V_HAA). haa_residual = actual_haa - OLS_expected_haa(mirrored_plate_x, mirrored_plate_x^2, mirrored_release_pos_x, release_speed) per pitch type, fit on training seasons only.

decision_rules.stage1_drop_rule: A drop is accepted if ALL hold: (i) score correlation with V0a >= 0.99; (ii) the 95% CI of the difference in every outcome correlation in (b) and (c) includes 0, or the variant is significantly better. Apply to V1 and V2 individually and to V3 jointly: if V3 passes, drop both; else if V1 and V2 each pass but V3 fails, drop only the one with the smaller absolute change on the primary metric; else drop whichever passes alone, or neither. If the V0a-vs-V0b difference is as large as the CI width, log the test as underpowered and keep the feature (conservative default).
decision_rules.stage2_haa_rule: Add HAA only if ALL hold: (i) lower bound of 95% CI of primary-metric improvement > 0 and same-season xFIP correlation not significantly worse; (ii) |corr(haa_residual, plate_x)| < 0.1 and |corr(haa_residual, release_pos_x)| < 0.1; (iii) variant's pitcher-season correlation with live Location+ and Deception+ scores rises by no more than 0.05 vs Vchosen. If haa_policy is force_include, include it and report the test result anyway.

metric_definitions.a_score_correlation_with_v0a: Pearson r of variant pitcher-season Stuff+ scores vs V0a pitcher-season Stuff+ scores, pooled across all CV folds, qualified pitcher-seasons only
metric_definitions.b_same_season_xfip_corr: Pearson r of pitcher-season Stuff+ score vs same-season xFIP (negative is correct direction - lower xFIP = better pitcher)
metric_definitions.c_next_season_xfip_corr: Pearson r of score(S) vs xFIP(S+1), PRIMARY METRIC, consecutive pairs excluding 2020 pairs
metric_definitions.c_next_season_era_corr: Pearson r of score(S) vs ERA(S+1)
metric_definitions.d_huber_loss: Per-pitch held-out Huber loss (delta=1.0), pooled over all OOF folds
metric_definitions.d_r2: Per-pitch R^2 of OOF predictions vs actual delta_run_exp
metric_definitions.yoy_stability: Pearson r of score(S) vs score(S+1) for consecutive pairs excluding 2020
metric_definitions.split_half_reliability: Spearman-Brown corrected split-half r at various pitch count cutoffs

lgbm_hyperparameters.note: Reused from live v3 training parameters (models/stuff_plus_v3_lgbm_meta.json)

excluded_seasons_note: 2020 excluded from training (60-game season, structural outlier); scored with season_flag='60-game season'
validation_type: descriptive (in-sample) for final model; out-of-sample evidence only from pitcher-holdout in ablation subsample (Part 2, labeled conservative)
